Guitar Hero - Greatest Hits.name: Guitar Hero: Smash Hits
Guitar Hero - Greatest Hits.summary:
Guitar Hero Smash Hits is the best of Guitar Hero music, now for the full band! Rock out to the most fun tracks from Guitar Hero, Guitar Hero II, Guitar Hero: Rock the 80's, and Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock, now for the full band. Using the controllers strum, drum, and belt out a collection of master tracks including Nirvana, Judas Priest, Slayer, Rage Against the Machine, Queen, and many more.

Titled Guitar Hero Greatest Hits in Europe and Australia.

Lost Planet - Extreme Condition.name: Lost Planet: Extreme Condition
Lost Planet - Extreme Condition.summary: The game is played through a third person over-the-shoulder view. Players are allowed to switch between first person and third person at any moment. Players either travel on foot or ride various types of mechanized suits called Vital Suits (VSs). VSs carry heavy weapons such as chainguns and rocket launchers. They can pick up weapons lying on the ground and fire multiple weapons at once. On foot, players are able to use a grappling hook to pull themselves up to normally hard-to-reach places, or to hook onto a VS and hijack it. Driving VSs and using certain weapons requires thermal energy. Also, the planet's cold temperature causes the characters' thermal energy level to continually decrease. Players can replenish their thermal energy level by defeating enemies or activating data posts. Data posts also allow players to use their navigational radars to see incoming enemies. Each of the 11 levels is accompanied by a boss, which can be either a VS or a large Akrid.

Madden NFL 10.name: Madden NFL 10
Madden NFL 10.summary: Madden NFL 10 also lets you take your fight online with an all-new Online Franchise mode, complete with 32 teams, NFL-style drafts and a custom league webpage. Add to that the most immersive broadcast presentation to date, and Madden NFL 10 gives you everything you see on Sundays, minus the grass.

Pachinko Hissatsu Shigotonin IV - Kyorak.name: Pachinko Hissatsu Shigotonin IV: Kyoraku Collection Vol. 2
Pachinko Hissatsu Shigotonin IV - Kyorak.summary: Pachinko Hissatsu Shigotonin IV: Kyoraku Collection Vol. 2 is a PlayStation 3 pachinko simulation based on the Hissatsu Shigotonin IV machine. Recreate its dramatic parlor play and effects, featuring six Shigotonin, including Nakamura Mondo, O-Riku, Kayo, and Junnosuke. Idol guest characters also appear as clients who request the Shigotonin’s help.

World of Outlaws - Sprint Cars.name: World of Outlaws: Sprint Cars
World of Outlaws - Sprint Cars.summary:
World of Outlaws: Sprint Cars is a dirt-track racing game that puts you behind the wheel of a sprint car, racing through mud and oil at iconic real-world venues. Solo players push hard against real champion drivers, while multiplayer fans can race with friends through a mix of split-screen and online modes.

With distinctive winged sprint cars, real-time track deformation that forces you to adapt your racing line, and a variety of tracks from the World of Outlaws series, the game delivers fast, gritty racing with plenty of competitive options for both online and offline sessions.
